remote_compare:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,time
root=Path("/home/yongpeng/cross-lingual")
out=root/"reports/seller_alias_continual/20260910/cause_train_execution/20260910_122620"
plan=json.loads((out/"copy_plan.json").read_text())
rows=[]
for r in plan["files"]:
 p=root/r["path"]
 same=p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size==r["bytes"] and hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==r["sha256"]
 rows.append({"path":r["path"],"match":same,"exists":p.exists()})
result={"status":"COMPARED_WITHOUT_LABEL_PARSE","rows":rows,"matched":sum(r["match"] for r in rows),"copy":[r["path"] for r in rows if not r["match"]]}
(out/"remote_comparison.json").write_text(json.dumps(result),encoding="utf-8")
print(json.dumps({"matched":result["matched"],"copy":result["copy"]}))
